_comment: Optimized MCP configuration with performance-tested installations. Constitutional Rule #0: NEVER write to .windsurf/plans/ or any out-of-repo path. Sovereign write territories: docs/reports/plans/, artifacts/adg/, artifacts/memory/, ops_scripts/ci/, tools/. Read-sensitive paths (NEVER write ad-hoc): agentic_core/adg/schema.py, agentic_core/adg/extraction/static_scanner.py, agentic_core/runtime/lifecycle_trace_contract.py. Generated/gitignored paths excluded: artifacts/adg/scan_result_cache.json, artifacts/memory/knowledge_graph.sqlite.
